caption: Each 2 × 2 block of the 4 × 4 grey grid is replaced by its average; the 2 × 2 grid has half the width and half the height, so it holds one quarter of the pixels. Notice that 4 and 7 are means, not copied samples.

spec.title: 4 × 4 image and its 2 × 2 average
spec.aria: A table showing a 4 by 4 grey image and the 2 by 2 image made by averaging each block of four pixels.
